publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Scientific algorithmic teaching reconstruction, not a photograph, scan, histology slide, laboratory result, measured structure, biomarker result, treatment recommendation, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: Current NLM MeSH, reviewed UniProtKB, and ExPASy ENZYME records supply controlled identity and conservative representation boundaries only; no source image or design is copied.

reviewStandard: Six deterministic disposition-revise records are re-audited against current controlled authorities and their literal revision-1 failures. Each old source remains immutable and non-public. Exactly one independent revision-2 call is permitted per hash-frozen prompt, followed by literal native-resolution output, prohibited-content, edge-field, crop, and exact-hash audit.
promotionRule: Only a literal revision-2 output matching its frozen representation boundary, fully opaque pale field, safe-edge requirements, and exact native audit may proceed to separate exact-hash Control Tower acceptance. Every prior revision-1 source remains immutable, rejected, and non-public.
